scope: Exactly94 selected new clips for the five revised books:46 pages,5 titles,43 missing word clips. This is a new-output report, not the complete cohort narration inventory; unchanged prior consumed audio must be reconciled separately.
method: Complete FFmpeg decode to finite24kHz PCM,50ms speech-window RMS and clipping/silence measurements; unprompted offline tiny.en recognition for all94 initial outputs, small.en discrepancy checks, and two-model checks of the final IPA-controlled Janeiro take.
limitations: Not human listening, auditory-identity certification, classroom or physical-device acceptance. Janeiro retains explicit residual rare-name ASR ambiguity. Homophones, apostrophe spelling and Cambridge U.S. de pronunciation have individual dispositions. Reader playback/interruption is verified separately.
